title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.23791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. translated_title: DrugHarness：一个用于计算药物发现的可演化智能体框架
translated_abstract: 计算药物发现要求智能体能够组合科学操作，并适应不断变化的证据与约束条件。在此，我们提出DrugHarness，一个将可组合的科学执行与条件性技能归纳相耦合的可演化智能体框架。其环境集成了超过80种科学操作、生物医学资源以及任务专用代码，并保留候选分子、结果与产出物之间的关联。DrugHarness从执行轨迹和结果反馈中归纳出包含可观测适用条件、推荐操作和支持证据的动作假设。一个独立的审查智能体通过来源验证以及必要时的针对性执行试验，对从这些假设派生的候选技能进行评估。被采纳的技能将指导后续任务，并通过反馈不断修订。在MolBench和SMDD-Bench上的评估展示了其在分子筛选、优化与受限分子设计方面的能力。
tldr: DrugHarness是一个可演化的智能体框架，它将80多种科学操作组合执行，并从执行轨迹中归纳、审查和持续修订可复用的条件性技能，从而适应计算药物发现中不断变化的证据与约束。
en_tdlr: DrugHarness is an evolvable agent harness that composes over 80 scientific operations and induces, reviews, and continuously refines conditional reusable skills from execution trajectories to adapt to changing evidence and constraints in computational drug discovery.
